financials.source: FY2025 operating figures from Becker's Hospital Review (March 2026) and BayCare 2025 Report to the Community. Total operating revenue $6.97B, operating income $821.4M (11.8% margin), net income $1.4B. Non-operating revenue derived as net income minus operating income. FY2024: revenue $6.27B, operating income $603.4M (9.6% margin), net income $1.2B. Total assets and liabilities not confirmed for FY2025; Q1 2023 combined balance sheet showed total assets of $11.58B. ProPublica Form 990 (EIN 59-2796965) for FY2024 shows ~$16B total assets and ~$9.09B liabilities for the filing entity, but this may reflect a parent/consolidated scope distinct from operating figures. NOTE: EIN in this dossier (59-3474479) was not found on ProPublica; the verified BayCare Health System EIN is 59-2796965.

balanceSheetWealth.investmentPortfolioSource: Pre-Trinity-split balance sheet (March 2020) showed ~$4.79B in investments. In 2024 BayCare paid Trinity Health $4B ($3B cash + $1B bridge loan) to dissolve the JOA. Current investment portfolio unavailable; post-split balance sheet not yet surfaced. Check BayCare FY2025 audited financials on EMMA or annual report for current figure.
balanceSheetWealth.realEstateSource: Q1 2023 combined balance sheet showed PP&E net of $2.38B. BayCare operates 15 hospitals and 300+ outpatient facilities across Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Polk, and Manatee counties.
balanceSheetWealth.notes: Trinity Health split finalized May 2024. BayCare paid $4B to acquire full independence. Post-split balance sheet will reflect significantly different asset composition. BayCare received $1.9B tax-exempt bond authorization in August 2024 from Hillsborough County IDA. Financial statements and Form 990 Schedule D would disclose investment and endowment details.

bondDebt.largestIssue: Hillsborough County IDA Health System Revenue Bonds Series 2024 (BayCare Health System)
bondDebt.source: Bond Buyer reported $1.3B priced week of Aug 19, 2024, underwritten by Morgan Stanley and Barclays. Fitch rated AA/Stable. Proceeds for capital reimbursement, future projects, capitalized interest, and issuance costs. Maximum rate 6.5%, latest maturity Dec 31, 2061. SEC fund filings show Series 2024-C with 4.125% coupon (Nov 2051 maturity) and 5.00% coupon (Nov 2029 maturity). BayCare received $1.9B total authorization from Hillsborough County IDA in Aug 2024. Total outstanding across all series not confirmed; check EMMA for full debt schedule. Pre-2024 debt included older series; 2010 total long-term debt was ~$794M (Fitch), now significantly higher.

relatedOrganizations.source: UNVERIFIED — requires Form 990 Schedule R for EIN 59-3474479. Known affiliated entities include BayCare Medical Group (physician group), BayCare Foundation (philanthropic arm), and individual hospital entities such as Morton Plant Hospital, Mease Countryside Hospital, Mease Dunedin Hospital, St. Joseph's Hospital (Tampa), St. Joseph's Women's Hospital, St. Joseph's Children's Hospital, South Florida Baptist Hospital, Bartow Regional Medical Center, Winter Haven Hospital, Winter Haven Women's Hospital, St. Anthony's Hospital, and BayCare Alliant Hospital. Schedule R would confirm all related organizations, EINs, and transaction amounts.

executiveComp.source: ProPublica Form 990 (EIN 59-2796965) FY2023. Stephanie Conners (President & CEO since Nov 28, 2022, succeeding Tommy Inzina who retired end of 2022): $2,488,756 reportable compensation from organization + $538,413 from related organizations = $3,027,169 total. Base/bonus/deferred breakdown requires Schedule J detail not available in search results. Prior CEO Tommy Inzina FY2021: ~$4,330,000 reportable + ~$74,000 other. FY2024 990 compensation not yet surfaced.

communityBenefit.source: BayCare 2025 Report to the Community (released April 2026): community benefit of $500M in 2025 (up from $467M in 2024) in categories of charity care, subsidizing the underinsured, and health-related social services. Pct calculated as $500M / $6.97B total operating revenue = 7.2%. The $500M figure includes more than charity care alone; charity care subtotal not broken out in press materials. FY2023 community benefit reported as $557M. Schedule H would provide exact charity care vs. other community benefit breakdown. Florida state average charity care pct and cost-to-charge ratio require AHCA data or Lown Hospitals Index.

taxAdvantage.notes: UNVERIFIED — BayCare Health System is a tax-exempt 501(c)(3) organization. Florida has no state income tax, so state income tax foregone would be $0. Property tax exemptions across approximately 16 hospitals and 300+ outpatient sites in Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, and Polk counties would represent a significant annual benefit. Florida sales tax exemption rate is 6% plus applicable county surtax.

accusation: BayCare Health System, a 501(c)(3) with $6.97 billion in operating revenue (FY2025), paid its CEO $3.03 million, issued $1.3 billion in tax-exempt bonds through the Hillsborough County IDA, and claims $500 million in community benefit (7.2% of revenue) while its charity care subtotal remains undisclosed; following its $4 billion buyout of Trinity Health's stake, the system's post-split investment portfolio and total debt remain opaque. This dossier's team pairing requires correction.
